what: a 4 x 3 profile drawn at the middle of the bottom line of a closed 60 x 40 rounded-rectangle path (corner radius 8) and swept round the whole path (walls offset, fillets turned the wrong way)
method: the profile is centred on the path and square to it, so every part of the path keeps it centred: V = A L with A = 12 and L = 2 * 44 + 2 * 24 + 4 (pi/2) 8 = 186.27 (Pappus on the arcs), V = 2235.2. The tube stays within 2 mm of the path sideways and 1.5 mm up: bbox x +-32, y +-22, z +-1.5.
